hooks.hook_text: You helped Adam’s team onboard 500 repositories in a single week to meet scaling demands.
hooks.rationale: Even though we don’t know your exact role, moving 500 repos quickly suggests you’re handling massive, manual data migrations that can strain operations.
hooks.bridge: Our platform can automate the reconciliation and tracking of those repository migrations, reducing errors and freeing engineers to focus on delivery.

hooks.hook_text: ShipBob’s new ‘ShipBob Promise’ delivery‑date engine aims to boost conversion by giving brands precise shipping dates.
hooks.rationale: As a leader in ShipBob’s supply‑chain operations, you’ll need to reconcile inventory, carrier, and order data to power that engine—an effort prone to manual errors.
hooks.bridge: We help operations teams automate those reconciliation‑heavy workflows, ensuring the delivery‑date engine runs on clean, real‑time data.
